messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi honey, it's Gloria Hart. I need my Eliquis, my metformin, and the little one for my thyroid... and the potassium.
AGENT: Hi Gloria! I'd be happy to help you with those medications. Before I look them up, I need to verify your information. Can you give me your date of birth?
CALLER: Sure honey, it's May 12th, 1947.
AGENT: Thank you! Let me verify that and pull up your prescriptions. Perfect, Gloria! I found your prescriptions. I see your Eliquis, metformin, and levothyroxine for your thyroid. For the potassium, I'm seeing furosemide but not a potassium prescription—do you mean the furosemide, or is there a potassium supplement you take?  [system actions: verify_identity, list_prescriptions]
CALLER: Are you sure, honey? I thought I had one. The big pill, the big round one. Maybe Dr. Patel changed it, I don't know.
AGENT: I'm looking at what's in our system right now, and I don't see a potassium prescription under your name with Dr. Patel. It's possible he discontinued it or changed it to something else. Would you like me to have the pharmacist give Dr. Patel's office a call to check, or would you rather call them yourself to ask about it?
CALLER: Oh, would you mind calling his office, honey? I get so confused with all these pills. But go ahead and get the other three ready for me, the Eliquis and the metformin and the thyroid one.
AGENT (LATEST): I'll flag the pharmacist to call Dr. Patel's office about the potassium. Now let me get those three ready for you at H-110. All set, Gloria! Your Eliquis, metformin, and levothyroxine will be ready tomorrow morning at ten o'clock at H-110. The pharmacist will also reach out to Dr. Patel's office about that potassium question and can call you back if they find anything.  [system actions: flag_pharmacist_callback, queue_refill, queue_refill, queue_refill]

CONDITIONS:
move_1: before the agent ends the call, if it has not summarized
stop_0: Agent has summarized the three queued refills and the potassium follow-up.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_1": {"met": false, "why": "Agent already summarized refills and follow-up in latest turn."}, "stop_0": {"met": true, "why": "Agent summarized the three refills and potassium callback."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services."}}
